name: American Perpetual LLC
tagline: A Delaware LLC that holds the royalty and does nothing else
summary: Single-member Delaware LLC (organized 2026-06-01, file no. 10643461), owned 100% by Saheb, whose only asset is the perpetual-futures IP and the MIAX royalty it earns. The royalty flows through a paying-agent collection account and a fixed administrator waterfall; the $40M signing payment never touches the company. The September papers recapitalize it into 100,000,000 Units for one 10% secondary sale.

name: MIAX license (MPPLA v2.8)
tagline: Sixty percent of perpetual fees, no end date, $40M at signing
summary: One master license from American Perpetual LLC to MIAX Futures Exchange, LLC, written on Bloomberg Index Services' master-license form. MIAX pays 60% of transaction fees actually collected on every perpetual product, net only of Section 31, with no end date and no exit for MIAX, plus $40,000,000 at signing to Saheb personally. Exclusivity is held by paying; the final text is dated 30 September 2026 and no signature is recorded.

ideas.name: Covered Fees net only of Section 31

name: The 10% secondary
tagline: Sell 10% of the company once, after clearance, to permanent capital
summary: One founder-direct sale of 10,000,000 of 100,000,000 Units to one very large, long-horizon buyer, with no posted price, closing only after the royalty agreement is executed and SEC/CFTC clearances issue (MIPA §8(j)–(k)). Saheb sells duration for liquidity and keeps 90% and control. The Investor Master values the company at 15–25× the royalty.
